WITH win_counts AS (
  SELECT driverId, COUNT(*) AS win_count
  FROM driverStandings
  WHERE wins = 1
  GROUP BY driverId
),
 top_driver AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM win_counts
  ORDER BY win_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.nationality,
       (SELECT MAX(points) FROM driverStandings WHERE driverId = td.driverId) AS max_points
FROM drivers d
JOIN top_driver td ON d.driverId = td.driverId
SELECT (strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', dob)) AS age, forename, surname FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'Japanese' AND dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob DESC LIMIT 1

WITH alex AS (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Alex' AND surname = 'Yoong') SELECT DISTINCT races.name FROM races JOIN results ON races.raceId = results.raceId JOIN alex ON results.driverId = alex.driverId WHERE results.positionOrder < 20

WITH schumacher AS (SELECT driverId FROM drivers WHERE forename = 'Michael' AND surname = 'Schumacher'), min_lap AS (SELECT MIN(milliseconds) AS min_ms FROM lapTimes WHERE driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM schumacher)) SELECT races.name, races.year FROM races JOIN lapTimes ON lapTimes.raceId = races.raceId JOIN schumacher ON lapTimes.driverId = schumacher.driverId WHERE lapTimes.milliseconds = (SELECT min_ms FROM min_lap) LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.country = 'Germany' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId WHERE r.name = 'European Grand Prix'
SELECT circuitRef FROM circuits WHERE name = 'Marina Bay Street Circuit'
SELECT nationality FROM drivers WHERE dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY dob ASC LIMIT 1

WITH lewis_results AS (
  SELECT res.raceId, res.rank
  FROM results AS res
  JOIN drivers AS d ON res.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE d.forename = 'Lewis' AND d.surname = 'Hamilton' AND res.rank IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT races.name
FROM lewis_results
JOIN races ON lewis_results.raceId = races.raceId
ORDER BY lewis_results.rank ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM circuits WHERE country = 'Australia' AND location = 'Adelaide'
SELECT DISTINCT c.name FROM constructors c JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId WHERE cr.raceId = 291 AND cr.points = 0

WITH champion AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM driverStandings
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT MAX(raceId) FROM races WHERE year = 2009)
    AND position = 1
),
champ_results AS (
  SELECT r.fastestLap,
         (CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, 1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':')-1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
          CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':')+1, instr(r.fastestLapTime, '.') - instr(r.fastestLapTime, ':') -1) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
          CAST(substr(r.fastestLapTime, instr(r.fastestLapTime, '.')+1) AS INTEGER)) AS total_ms
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON r.raceId = ra.raceId
  JOIN champion c ON r.driverId = c.driverId
  WHERE ra.year = 2009
    AND r.fastestLap IS NOT NULL
    AND r.fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT fastestLap
FROM champ_results
ORDER BY total_ms ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT driverRef FROM drivers WHERE nationality = 'German' AND dob IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(strftime('%Y', REPLACE(dob, '/', '-')) AS INTEGER) ASC LIMIT 1

WITH youngest_driver AS (
  SELECT d.driverId
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE d.dob IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY d.driverId, d.dob
  ORDER BY d.dob DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
first_race AS (
  SELECT r.year, r.name, r.date, r.time
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE q.driverId = (SELECT driverId FROM youngest_driver)
  ORDER BY r.date ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT year, name, date, time FROM first_race

WITH driver_avg AS (
  SELECT d.driverId,
         d.forename,
         d.surname,
         SUM(CAST(p.duration AS REAL)) / COUNT(p.duration) AS avg_duration
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN pitStops p ON d.driverId = p.driverId
  WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1985
  GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname
)
SELECT forename, surname
FROM driver_avg
ORDER BY avg_duration ASC
LIMIT 3

WITH race AS (SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2008 AND name = 'Canadian Grand Prix') SELECT d.forename, d.surname, res.time AS finish_time FROM results res JOIN race r ON res.raceId = r.raceId JOIN drivers d ON res.driverId = d.driverId WHERE res.positionOrder = 1

WITH race AS (
  SELECT raceId FROM races WHERE year = 2009 AND name = 'Singapore Grand Prix'
),
winner AS (
  SELECT constructorId
  FROM results
  WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race)
    AND time = (SELECT MAX(time) FROM results WHERE raceId = (SELECT raceId FROM race))
)
SELECT c.constructorRef, c.url
FROM constructors c
JOIN winner w ON c.constructorId = w.constructorId

WITH league_id_cte AS (
  SELECT id FROM League WHERE name = 'Scotland Premier League'
),
away_wins AS (
  SELECT m.away_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS win_count
  FROM Match m
  JOIN league_id_cte l ON m.league_id = l.id
  WHERE m.season = '2009/2010'
    AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal
  GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id
),
max_wins AS (
  SELECT away_team_api_id
  FROM away_wins
  ORDER BY win_count DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Team t
JOIN max_wins mw ON t.team_api_id = mw.away_team_api_id
WITH team_max AS (SELECT team_api_id, MAX(buildUpPlaySpeed) AS max_speed FROM Team_Attributes GROUP BY team_api_id) SELECT max_speed FROM team_max ORDER BY max_speed DESC LIMIT 4
SELECT L.name FROM League L JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id WHERE M.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY L.id, L.name ORDER BY SUM(M.home_team_goal = M.away_team_goal) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT team_fifa_api_id FROM Team_Attributes WHERE buildUpPlaySpeed > 50 AND buildUpPlaySpeed < 60

WITH avg_passing AS (
  SELECT SUM(ta.buildUpPlayPassing) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.team_long_name) AS avg_pass
  FROM Team_Attributes ta
  JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
  WHERE strftime('%Y', REPLACE(ta.date, '/', '-')) = '2012'
    AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT t.team_long_name
FROM Team_Attributes ta
JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
CROSS JOIN avg_passing ap
WHERE strftime('%Y', REPLACE(ta.date, '/', '-')) = '2012'
  AND ta.buildUpPlayPassing > ap.avg_pass

SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player)
SELECT p.player_name FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE pa.overall_rating IS NOT NULL ORDER BY pa.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name FROM Team T JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team T JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge' ORDER BY TA.date DESC LIMIT 1

WITH heaviest AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM Player
  WHERE weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN heaviest h ON pa.player_api_id = h.player_api_id
ORDER BY pa.date DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT T.team_long_name FROM Match M JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)

       (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', REPLACE(p.Birthday, '/', '-')) AS INTEGER)) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.RVVT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Diagnosis FROM Patient P JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2

WITH oldest_sjs AS (
  SELECT `ID`, `Birthday`, `First Date`
  FROM `Patient`
  WHERE `Diagnosis` = 'SJS' AND `Birthday` IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY date(REPLACE(`Birthday`, '/', '-')) ASC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  (SELECT MAX(date(REPLACE(`Date`, '/', '-'))) FROM `Laboratory` WHERE `ID` = oldest_sjs.`ID`) AS lab_completion_date,
  (strftime('%Y', date(REPLACE(oldest_sjs.`First Date`, '/', '-'))) - strftime('%Y', date(REPLACE(oldest_sjs.`Birthday`, '/', '-')))) AS age_at_admission
FROM oldest_sjs

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN `Date` LIKE '1981-11-%' THEN `T-CHO` END) - SUM(CASE WHEN `Date` LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN `Date` LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN `T-CHO` END) AS decrease_rate FROM Laboratory WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Patient WHERE Birthday = '1959-02-18') AND (`Date` LIKE '1981-11-%' OR `Date` LIKE '1981-12-%')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS'

SELECT DISTINCT `Patient`.`ID` FROM `Patient` JOIN `Laboratory` ON `Patient`.`ID` = `Laboratory`.`ID` WHERE `Patient`.`SEX` = 'M' AND `Laboratory`.`GPT` >= 60
SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.UN = 29

WITH high_chol AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.`ID`, p.`Birthday`
  FROM `Patient` p
  JOIN `Laboratory` l ON p.`ID` = l.`ID`
  WHERE p.`SEX` = 'M'
    AND l.`T-CHO` >= 250
    AND p.`Birthday` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CAST(SUM(strftime('%Y','now') - strftime('%Y', `Birthday`)) AS REAL) / COUNT(`ID`) FROM high_chol

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, (strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday)) AS age FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.GLU >= 180 AND l."T-CHO" < 250 AND l.GLU IS NOT NULL AND l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL

WITH low_rbc AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT L.ID
  FROM Laboratory L
  WHERE L.RBC < 3.5
)
SELECT P.ID,
       (CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age,
       P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN low_rbc LR ON P.ID = LR.ID
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.WBC > 3.5 AND L.WBC < 9.0 AND (L.FG <= 150 OR L.FG >= 450)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory L JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID WHERE L.IGG > 900 AND L.IGG < 2000 AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGA > 80 AND l.IGA < 500 AND p.`First Date` IS NOT NULL AND CAST(strftime('%Y', REPLACE(p.`First Date`, '/', '-')) AS INTEGER) >= 1990
SELECT `Diagnosis` FROM `Patient` WHERE `ID` IN (SELECT DISTINCT `ID` FROM `Laboratory` WHERE `IGM` <= 40 OR `IGM` >= 400) GROUP BY `Diagnosis` ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

WITH ref AS (SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', MAX("Date")) AS INTEGER) AS yr FROM "Laboratory"), abnormal AS (SELECT DISTINCT "ID" FROM "Laboratory" WHERE "CRE" >= 1.5) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM "Patient" p JOIN abnormal a ON p."ID" = a."ID" CROSS JOIN ref r WHERE p."Birthday" IS NOT NULL AND (r.yr - CAST(strftime('%Y', REPLACE(p."Birthday", '/', '-')) AS INTEGER)) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') AND L.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND P.SEX = 'M'
SELECT MAX("Birthday") FROM "Patient" INNER JOIN "Laboratory" ON "Patient"."ID" = "Laboratory"."ID" WHERE "Laboratory"."GOT" >= 60

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Laboratory L WHERE L.ID = P.ID AND L.CPK < 250) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Examination E WHERE E.ID = P.ID AND (E.KCT = '+' OR E.RVVT = '+' OR E.LAC = '+'))

SELECT notes FROM income WHERE source = 'Fundraising' AND date_received = '2019-09-14'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE major.major_name = 'Business' AND member.t_shirt_size = 'Medium'
SELECT DISTINCT major.department FROM member JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id WHERE member.position = 'President'
SELECT e.event_name FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.status = 'Closed' ORDER BY CAST(b.spent AS REAL) / b.amount DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT MAX(spent) FROM budget
SELECT SUM(spent) FROM budget WHERE category = 'Food'

SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM attendance a INNER JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id INNER JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya' AND m.last_name = 'Mclean' AND e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS attended
SELECT e.event_name FROM event AS e JOIN budget AS b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event WHERE e.status = 'Closed' AND b.remaining < 0 ORDER BY b.remaining ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT `budget`.`category` AS `type`, SUM(`expense`.`cost`) AS `total_value` FROM `event` JOIN `budget` ON `budget`.`link_to_event` = `event`.`event_id` JOIN `expense` ON `expense`.`link_to_budget` = `budget`.`budget_id` WHERE `event`.`event_name` = 'October Meeting' AND `expense`.`approved` = 'true' GROUP BY `budget`.`category`
SELECT SUM(cost) FROM expense WHERE expense_date = '2019-08-20'

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost FROM member m JOIN expense e ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member WHERE m.member_id = 'rec4BLdZHS2Blfp4v' GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
SELECT DISTINCT expense.expense_description FROM expense JOIN member ON expense.link_to_member = member.member_id WHERE member.first_name = 'Sacha' AND member.last_name = 'Harrison'
SELECT DISTINCT type FROM event WHERE location = 'MU 215'
SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name, i.amount FROM income i JOIN member m ON i.link_to_member = m.member_id WHERE i.date_received = '2019-09-09'

SELECT AVG(ym.Consumption) / 12 FROM yearmonth ym JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID WHERE c.Segment = 'SME' AND ym.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM customers WHERE Segment = 'SME'
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Consumption > 528.3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM yearmonth WHERE Date = '201202'
SELECT DISTINCT p.Description FROM transactions_1k t JOIN products p ON t.ProductID = p.ProductID WHERE strftime('%Y%m', t.Date) = '201309'

SELECT DISTINCT g.Country

SELECT customers.Segment FROM customers JOIN transactions_1k ON customers.CustomerID = transactions_1k.CustomerID WHERE transactions_1k.Date = '2012-08-23' AND transactions_1k.Time = '21:20:00'

WITH cust AS (SELECT CustomerID FROM transactions_1k WHERE Date = '2012-08-25' AND Price = 634.8 LIMIT 1), cons AS (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2012%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2012, SUM(CASE WHEN Date LIKE '2013%' THEN Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons_2013 FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = (SELECT CustomerID FROM cust)) SELECT (cons_2012 - cons_2013) / cons_2012 AS consumption_decrease_rate FROM cons
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Segment = 'Premium' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM gasstations WHERE Country = 'SVK'
SELECT (SELECT SUM(Amount) FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = 38508) AS total_amount, (SELECT Consumption FROM yearmonth WHERE CustomerID = 38508 AND Date = '201201') AS jan2012_amount

WITH cust_spending AS (
  SELECT
    t.CustomerID,
    SUM(t.Price) AS total_price,
    SUM(t.Amount) AS total_amount
  FROM transactions_1k t
  GROUP BY t.CustomerID
),
 top_customer AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, total_price, total_amount
  FROM cust_spending
  ORDER BY total_price DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  tc.CustomerID,
  CAST(tc.total_price AS REAL) / CAST(tc.total_amount AS REAL) AS avg_price_per_item,
  c.Currency
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN customers c ON tc.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
